en.Poniższy opis zawiera wszystkie elementy: The description below includes all elements required by the project funding agreement.
The “STOP DYSKRYMINACJI” project no. FEWP.06.10-IP.01-0136/25 is co-funded by the European Union from the European Social Fund Plus under the European Funds for Wielkopolska 2021–2027 programme.
en.Celem projektu jest wzmocnienie od 1 sie: From 1 August 2026 to 29 February 2028, the project aims to strengthen equal opportunities and promote an inclusive culture in the Wielkopolska labour market by improving the skills of people responsible for company management and personnel policy; increasing the knowledge of people experiencing discrimination about their rights and ways to respond to unequal treatment; improving their social situation; raising companies’ awareness of discrimination in employment; and making knowledge and practical tools supporting equal treatment more accessible.
en.W ramach projektu realizowane są następu: The project includes the following tasks:
en.Opracowanie i uruchomienie platformy int: Developing and launching an online platform promoting equality and preventing discrimination in employment, together with publications: the Equality and Inclusion Code, guides for people experiencing and witnessing discrimination, a compendium of good practices, and twelve articles;
en.Warsztaty w zakresie zarządzania różnoro: Workshops on managing diversity and building an inclusive workplace;
en.Poradnictwo prawne dla osób doświadczają: Legal counselling for people experiencing discrimination;
en.Poradnictwo psychologiczne dla osób dośw: Psychological counselling for people experiencing discrimination.
en.Projekt skierowany jest do 330 osób uczą: The project is aimed at 330 people studying, working or living in the Wielkopolska region, as well as people experiencing homelessness who are staying in the region. This includes 100 people experiencing labour-market discrimination on grounds of sex, age, nationality or disability, and 230 company employees responsible for management and personnel policy. Priority is given to people experiencing multiple discrimination and representatives of micro and small businesses.
en.Zakładane rezultaty projektu: 220 osób u: The project’s expected results are that 220 people will gain qualifications after leaving the programme and the social situation of 54 people will improve after leaving the programme. A publicly accessible online platform will be launched with materials supporting equal treatment in employment.
